cues: See the proximity rule work both ways.
Neither the principal nor the teachers are willing: the nearer subject, teachers, is plural.
Turn it round: neither the teachers nor the principal is willing: the nearer subject is singular.
And remember, as well as is not and: Hari as well as his friends was absent.
text: See the proximity rule work both ways. Neither the principal nor the teachers are willing: the nearer subject, teachers, is plural.
